actor script interpreter: A5 = (A6)+0x16, opcode = byte (A5) -> 17-entry handler table at 0x68628.  Opcode map (handler, record size): 0 0x686ac hold: frame u32@2 for u8@1 ticks via 0xf08/0xf2e, 0 = forever (6); 1 0x686f4 palette alloc u16@2 (4); 2 0x6870a loop: jump to u32@2 u8@1 times, then fall through (6); 3 0x68732 jsr u24@1 (4); 4 0x6874a PC = u24@1 (4); 5 0x6875a (A6+u8@3) = u8@2 (4); 6 0x6876e (A6+u8@1) = u16@2 (4); 7 0x68782 (A6+u8@1) = u32@2 (6); 8 0x687b4 byte compare + cc (8); 9 0x687ae stop, return carry set (1); 10 0x6886a spawn child, handler u24@1 (4); 11 0x68796 ((A6)+0xc)+u8@3 = u8@2 (4); 12 0x6884c word compare + cc (8); 13 0x6888c hold: 0x6f02e(u8@3) then 0xf08 for u8@2 ticks (4); 14 0x688ca call 0x804de(u16@2) (4); 15 0x6867e hold as op 0 until the deferred record (A6)+0x1c returns carry, then PC = its resume long (6); 16 0x6866c defer record at PC+2, PC += 0xa (10).  Compare records: {u8 op, u24 true_addr, u8 cc, u8 actor_offset, u8/u16 value, pad}; flags from field - value; cc table 0x687d4 -> 0x6881c..0x68848 (table re-read from 0x68628 in the semantic pass; the earlier map had 8/10/11 rotated).  Called by the contact spawn 0x6854c, the effect init 0x68b88 and any script-driven actor

mode-select input: with two players (players_in_play_count 0xf3d2 == 2) sets the bounds +$48/+$49 to 1..2 (once; skipped when +$49 == 2); right/left press edges (0x10d52b bits 3/2) step +$13, wrapping between the bounds (signed compares)
blits the bank image 0x23bf40 (0x14 x 0x10 cells) through the sprite-map blit wrapper 0xd2ce; the image is one of the course backdrop cell blocks (docs/lanes/p1-bank.md)

mode-select panel state (installed by 0x6a86c; not an aim/ball marker): eases x toward its own target +$40 (0x6aa6e, factor $20), runs 0x6a974 (palette pick), 0x6a9a6 (layout) and actor_draw each frame; on arrival sets the director's +$11 bit 0, waits for its bit 1 (commit), then sets bit 2 and parks on 0x6a952 (semantic-review-p1-69f74)

mode-select panel palette pick (not a marker): +$20 = +$22 when game_mode 0x102eba is negative (nothing committed) and players_in_play_count 0xf3d2 is 2, or when game_mode >= 1; one-way swap (semantic-review-p1-69f74)

mode-select panel layout (not a marker): y $128, sort key $a, or $d for the panel matching director +$13 & 3 (selection 0/1/2); the matching panel copies its x into the director's +$30 (cursor base x); which key draws in front is not established (semantic-review-p1-69f74)
copies the parent's x/y zoom bytes and offsets its position by the (A6)+0x44/+0x46 deltas scaled by (parent x zoom + 1)/256, priority = parent + 1, then draws (semantic-review-p1-69f74)

moves (A6)+0x30 toward D0 with an 8.8 velocity (target - pos) * D1 (proportional, not a fixed step), stored at +$36, through 0x57034; equality or a delta sign change clamps x and returns carry (semantic-review-p1-69f74)
y twin of 0x6aa6e: moves (A6)+0x32 toward D0 with velocity (target - pos) * D1 in 8.8 (+$38, 0x5704c); carry when arrived (semantic-review-p1-69f74)

draws its own frame at the parent mode-select panel's position; players_in_play_count == 2 switches +$20 to +$22 (one-way); copies the parent's zoom bytes and sort key - 1 (not its frame or flip), calls 0x5706a; not a marker (semantic-review-p1-69f74)
copies the parent's zoom/flip and position and draws through 0xf08

course-select director: counts +$14 down, calls 0x6aea4 (four course cards) and spawns 0x6b712 (panel + countdown), then walks its OWN +$11 (written by its children): bit 0 sound $10d8 + cursor 0x6b05c, bit 6 spawns fade_actor_start 0xf42c, nonzero again at the fade end -> parent +$11 = -1 and release; other bits 1 commit, 3 timer expired, 4 cards fly out, 5 panel releases (semantic-review-p1-69f74)

spawns the four select-screen character actors from the tables 0x6add6 (0x10fd83 == 0), 0x6ae14 (== 1) or 0x6ae5c (else, +0x12 per index), seeding each actor's record pointer (A0)+0x16, y/x (0x30/0x32) and view fields (0x40/0x42)

select card fly-in state: steps x and y toward (A6)+0x40/+0x42 by 0x40 through 0x6aa6e/0x6aaa2, then spawns the two card actor sets (0x6affe with frame (A1)+0xe and 0x6b03a with frame (A1)+4 and palette (A1)+0xc) when the parent bit 4 is set, and moves the card by 0x700/0x500 steps toward (0xa0,0x150) until x is outside (-0x50,0x190)
waits for the 0x5707c gate (D0 = 0x18) then sets the resume PC 0x6b02e and draws the parent's frame
draws the parent's frame at its own position (0x5706a + 0xf08)

sets the card slot (A6)+0x13 from the roulette position (A6)+0x41 & 3 through the byte table 0x6b204 {0,2,3,1}; used only by the C+A roulette of 0x6b08c; not an animation counter (semantic-review-p1-69f74)
(A6)+0x30/+0x32 = words +8/+0xa of the (A6)+0x13th 0x12-byte record of the table 0x6adcc

moves the course-select cursor on the 2x2 card grid: slot (A6)+0x13 bit 0 = row, bit 1 = column; press edges in 0x10d52b (up/down clear/set bit 0, left/right bit 1, no wrap); on a change clears the blink counter +$40 and plays 0x1067 (semantic-review-p1-69f74)

course-select cursor state: per frame 0x6b236 + 0x6b218, blinks 16/16 via +$40; commit on the A edge (0x10d52b bit 4, with C held a roulette over 0x6b204 first) or timer expiry (parent bit 3): sound $1061, parent bit 1, writes course_index 0x10d4b8 from the 0x6b156/0x6b15e/0x6b166 slot tables by 0x10fd83, course sound from 0x6b16e, 30 blink frames, then 0x6b37a (semantic-review-p1-69f74)

course commit (cursor actor after 0x6b08c): sets the director's +$11 bit 4 (cards fly out), reads the 12-byte record 0x6b28e + course_index*$c {palette stream, image record, image record or 0} (reads 0x10d4b8, does not write it), runs the stream (0xb9bde), spawns two 0x6b446 children, points slot $28 at palette $17b as an animated source (0xb9d90), +$3a = $14, installs 0x6b3e4 (semantic-review-p1-69f74)

scenery record actor: record (A6)+0x16 = {source long (0x23xxxx bank image), correction words d6/d7, allocation word, position word} (records 0x6b2be..0x6b2ee); calls 0xd3d8 (d1 = $10) with the parent's +$3a zoom and caches the returned slot endpoints at +$40/+$42 (not a screen position); then 0x6b49c; a 0 pointer releases at once (semantic-review-p1-69f74)
